description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure and add AdoNet-based Grain Directory in Orleans hosting.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring AdoNet Grain Directory in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use AdoNet Grain Directory as default, with configuration options.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Overload that accepts an OptionsBuilder configuration action for AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds an AdoNet Grain Directory with specified name and options configuration.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory (overload)
methods.description: Overload that accepts OptionsBuilder configuration action for AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions.
